Equation 17:
\nu_{\mathrm{N}}=\frac{\nu_{\mathrm{n m}}\times S_{\mathrm{N O3}}}{S_{\mathrm{N O3\_0}}}

Symbols (as printed -> plain name to use):
  \nu_{N}  ->  nuN   (Nitrate uptake rate.)
  Q_{n}  ->  Qn   (Total nitrogen-to-carbon quota, calculated as cellular nitrogen divided by total fixed organic carbon.)
  S_{NO3}  ->  SNO3   (Concentration of nitrate as N in the reactor)
  S_{NO3_0}  ->  SNO30   (Initial extracellular nitrate concentration used to normalize nitrate uptake.)
  Q_{nm}  ->  Qnm   (Quota parameter regulating the nitrate uptake rate.)
  \nu_{nm}  ->  nunm   (Maximum nitrate uptake rate.)
  q_{n}  ->  qn   (Quota parameter in the nitrogen-quota-regulated partitioning of fixed carbon.)
